checks.name: regression-suite
checks.command: cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-embodiment -p truelearner-workstation && cargo test --locked --manifest-path academy/Cargo.toml -p academy-body --lib

findings: The smallest surviving binocular acquisition law is the product of signed eye-local retinal placement and movement-caused visual return; it does not introduce a fused depth channel, vergence command, target coordinate, desired direction, or evaluator input.

The reduced research composition reached exact joint alignment in all six outward and inward far, middle, and near relations. Separation at best joint alignment was ordered exactly as 32, 96, and 160 in both mirrors.

Collapsing signed placement never improved joint error. Removing movement-caused visual return produced zero retinal transitions and failed the outward-near joint alignment, separating closed visual control from lucky open-loop visits.

The preregistered threshold-factorized candidate was over-composed. Removing the intensity factor strengthened this binary spatial task, so the original threshold-necessity prediction is preserved as falsified rather than rewritten.

Academy now requires repeated opposing movements that reduce each eye's external target error and change actual light. The unchanged Production body therefore retains BinocularDepth as its honest first course failure.
A freshly generated Production visual-reach trace remains byte-identical with SHA-256 4be6c6f75aefe9dc2f38d019ce0f4f9133b26d650e0016a5b5b051f40241b2af.
residual_uncertainty: The result establishes bounded alignment acquisition, not stable fixation: the retained trace includes departures after exact alignment, especially the inward middle relation.
The stimulus is a generated vertical light edge. Transfer to natural image features, richer stereo correspondence, depth-directed reaching, and general three-dimensional perception remain unproved.
This is development evidence for a research-only composition, not a frozen authority run or Production-default adoption.
